n13338619.definition: an electrical device used to create artificial light by use of an electric lamp; all light fixtures have a fixture body and a light socket to hold the lamp and allow for its replacement

n13338910.definition: a trained person hired to determine the sex of chicken and other hatchlings.
examples: Chick sexing is the method of distinguishing the sex of chicken and other hatchlings, usually by a trained person called a chick sexer or chicken sexer.
